items.title: Show HN: Slash-tokens – know LLM cost before the call leaves your machine
items.why_it_matters: Slash-tokens is a 4.8KB WASM-based npm package that estimates LLM token costs locally, allowing you to block or switch models before a request leaves your machine. Since you are building AI-ingest and calling Claude APIs, this helps you prevent accidental high-cost API bills during development. Run `npm install slash-tokens` in your AI-ingest repo today to intercept and log estimated costs before your backend calls the Anthropic API.

items.title: Show HN: MulmoTerminal – Run many Claude Code sessions, see which needs you
items.why_it_matters: MulmoTerminal is a new open-source tool designed to run and monitor multiple Claude Code sessions simultaneously from a single interface. As you build AI-ingest, this lets you run one Claude Code session for your Next.js frontend and another for your Supabase backend without losing track of either. Clone the repo and run it alongside your current project to see if multi-session Claude Code speeds up your shipping loop this week.

items.title: Pgbot: A 5.9 MB read-only Postgres tool for humans and agents
items.why_it_matters: Pgbot is a tiny, 5.9 MB read-only Postgres tool designed specifically for both humans and AI agents to query databases safely. Since you use Supabase, you can expose this safe, read-only interface to Claude Code so it can inspect your database schema and run test queries without any risk of dropping tables or corrupting data. Download the binary and point it at your local Supabase Postgres instance to let Claude safely analyze your database structure during your next build session.

items.title: Yeschef: Claude Code dispatches work to Ollama on my LAN (627 tok/s on 3 NUCs)
items.why_it_matters: Yeschef is a utility that lets Claude Code offload heavy, repetitive background tasks to local Ollama models running on your local network. This fits the high-value strategy of saving Claude API tokens by delegating non-critical reasoning or boilerplate generation to free, local models. Install Yeschef and configure it to route simple code-generation tasks to a local model while keeping Claude Code active for complex architectural decisions.
